details.description: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live is Google's real-time speech-to-text model for the Gemini Live API. It streams continuous raw 16-bit PCM audio over a WebSocket connection and returns incremental, low-latency text transcriptions as speech occurs, per Google's Live Transcription guide. Unlike the file-based gemini-3.5-transcribe model, it does not support speaker diarization or word-level timestamps, but it shares the same 85+-language automatic detection and up-to-1,000-term custom vocabulary biasing, and its sessions are limited to 10 minutes, per Google's model feature-comparison table. It is generally available, last updated August 2026.
advantages: Emits low-latency interim (speculative) transcriptions while the speaker is talking, plus a finalized transcript once they pause, per Google's Live Transcription guide.
Automatically detects 85+ languages, including mid-session code-switching, per Google's model feature-comparison table.
Accepts custom vocabulary biasing of up to 1,000 domain-specific terms, per Google's model feature-comparison table.
Runs as a dedicated real-time speech-recognition pipeline over the Live API, distinct from its conversational Live Agent mode, per Google's Live Transcription guide.
disadvantages: Does not support speaker diarization or word-level timestamps, unlike the file-based gemini-3.5-transcribe model, per Google's model feature-comparison table.
Sessions are limited to 10 minutes, versus up to 1 hour for file-based transcription with gemini-3.5-transcribe, per Google's model feature-comparison table.
Accepts only raw audio input, unlike the Live API's conversational agent mode which also takes text, video and images, per Google's Live Transcription guide.
use_cases: Real-time live captioning or subtitles for a live audio stream, per Google's Live Transcription guide.
Low-latency voice-driven interfaces built on the Gemini Live API, per Google's Live Transcription guide.
Streaming multilingual transcription with automatic language detection, per Google's model feature-comparison table.

sources.title: Live transcription with Gemini Live API | Gemini API

notes: This model has no standalone model-card page (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.5-transcribe-live returns 404); its specification comes from the feature-comparison table on the gemini-3.5-transcribe model page (which documents both endpoints together) and from Google's Live Transcription guide, so website_url points to the latter. The named 85+ language list is given on the gemini-3.5-transcribe page under a heading covering 'its two endpoints'; I applied the same list here since the comparison table states both endpoints support the same language set. No WER or other accuracy figures were found.
